spec.prompt: Night in the frozen taiga: the cosmonaut Alexei Leonov (face and suit exactly as in the first two reference images) and the commander Pavel Belyayev (face and suit exactly as in his reference images), wrapped in pieces of the orange parachute, sit close to a small crackling fire in the snow beside the dark capsule. Beyond the firelight, between black tree trunks, pairs of wolves' eyes glint in the darkness. Sparks rise into falling snow. Photorealistic, shot on 35mm film, IMAX documentary realism in the spirit of Apollo 11 (2019) and Gravity. Accurate 1965 Soviet hardware: the white Berkut spacesuit with rust-orange harness straps, a white helmet with red CCCP letters above the visor, Soviet markings only. Hard directional sunlight, deep black space, crisp silhouettes. No on-screen text, no captions.
